programs.name: suinterp
programs.purpose: Interpolate traces between input traces using automatically estimated event dips.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUINTERP - interpolate traces using automatic event picking

params.name: ninterp
params.description: Number of interpolated traces between input traces.

params.name: nxmax
params.description: Maximum number of input traces; input reading stops at this limit.

params.name: freq1
params.description: Lower corner frequency for the picking model.

params.name: freq2
params.description: Upper corner frequency for the picking model.

params.name: deriv
params.description: Take a time derivative of the picking section when nonzero.

params.name: linear
params.description: Use linear interpolation instead of eight-point sinc when nonzero.

params.name: lent
params.description: Time smoothing length in samples, rounded up to an odd number.

params.name: lenx
params.description: Spatial smoothing length in traces, rounded up to an odd number.

params.name: lagc
params.description: AGC length in milliseconds for dip estimation.

params.name: xopt
params.description: Use differences for the spatial derivative when nonzero; fewer than 16 traces force differences.

params.name: iopt
params.description: Output interpolated traces, the picking model, or dip picks for values 0, 1, or 2.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Report temporary-file information when nonzero.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise ""
params.description: Directory for the temporary header file.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT filtering and derivatives, running-sum smoothing, dip division, and sinc or linear interpolation depend on operation order and float rounding. The linear branch interpolates both sides from the preceding trace array, unlike the sinc branch. Interpolated headers copy the preceding input header.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers traces on disk and combines FFT filtering, dip estimation, smoothing, and interpolation.

test_cases.description: Sinc interpolation with FFT spatial derivatives.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=24 | suinterp ninterp=2 nxmax=24 freq1=4 freq2=20 xopt=0

test_cases.description: Linear interpolation with difference derivatives and spatial smoothing.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suinterp ninterp=1 linear=1 deriv=1 xopt=1 lent=3 lenx=3 lagc=100
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suinterp iopt=1 freq1=0 freq2=15
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suinterp iopt=2 xopt=1

programs.name: suinterpfowler
programs.purpose: Interpolate an output image from velocity and eta panels using a specified model.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUINTERPFOWLER - interpolate output image from constant velocity panels

params.name: vmin
params.description: Minimum velocity in the input panels.

params.name: vmax
params.description: Maximum velocity in the input panels.

params.name: nv
params.description: Number of velocity panels.

params.name: etamin
params.description: Minimum eta in the input panels.

params.name: etamax
params.description: Maximum eta in the input panels.

params.name: neta
params.description: Number of eta panels.

params.name: ncdps
params.description: Number of output CDP positions.

params.name: nvstack
params.description: Number of CVS velocity stack panels; values greater than 5 select CVS mode.

params.name: vminstack
params.description: Minimum CVS velocity used in the stack spacing formula; the selfdoc says 1450, but the code sets 0.25.

params.name: vscale
params.description: Scale factor applied to model velocities.

params.name: cdp
params.description: Repeated CDP control-point positions. Despite the documented default, no value is initialized if omitted; at least one is needed for valid execution.

params.name: t
params.description: Repeated time arrays, one per CDP; each must match its velocity array. The documented default is not applied by code.

params.name: v
params.description: Repeated velocity arrays, one per CDP; the documented default is not applied by code.

params.name: eta
params.description: Repeated eta arrays, one per CDP, required by count checks in non-CVS mode when CDPs are supplied; the documented default is not applied by code.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Time, CDP, velocity, and eta interpolation mix float arithmetic with double literals; CVS mode transforms velocity to inverse squared velocity. Float-to-int truncation determines panel indices. No CDP control points causes out-of-bounds access; zero velocity spacing can cause division by zero. The upper panel boundary is excluded.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers multiple panels per CDP and interpolates a time-varying model across CDP, velocity, and eta.

test_cases.description: Interpolate velocity and eta panels at two CDPs.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suinterpfowler ncdps=2 nv=2 neta=2 vmin=1500 vmax=2500 etamin=0 etamax=0.2 cdp=0 t=0,0.4 v=1800,2000 eta=0.05,0.1 cdp=1 t=0,0.4 v=1900,2100 eta=0.1,0.15

test_cases.description: Interpolate CVS panels with scaled velocities.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=12 | suinterpfowler ncdps=2 nvstack=6 vminstack=1500 vscale=1 cdp=0 t=0,0.4 v=1700,1800

programs.name: suocext
programs.purpose: Extrapolate common-offset seismic gathers to a smaller offset using offset continuation.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUOCEXT - smaller Offset EXTrapolation via Offset Continuation

params.name: cdpmin
params.description: Minimum CDP bin number to process.

params.name: cdpmax
params.description: Maximum CDP bin number to process.

params.name: dxcdp
params.description: Distance between adjacent CDP bins.

params.name: noffmix
params.description: Number of offsets to mix.

params.name: offextr
params.description: Target offset.

params.name: tdmo
params.description: Increasing times for the RMS velocity function.

params.name: vdmo
params.description: RMS velocities corresponding to tdmo; array lengths must match.

params.name: sdmo
params.description: DMO stretch factor.

params.name: fmax
params.default: computed: 0.5/dt, where dt is the first trace header interval in seconds
params.description: Maximum input frequency.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print diagnostics when nonzero.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise ""
params.description: Directory for the temporary header file.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT transforms, sinc and cubic interpolation, offset mixing, and stretch calculations are sensitive to accumulation order and float rounding; pow, sqrt, log, sin, and cos can vary by math library. Small or invalid time, velocity, stretch, or frequency values can cause divisions by zero or invalid math.
programs.difficulty_reason: It implements frequency-wavenumber offset continuation with nonlinear time stretching, FFTs, interpolation, and multi-offset state.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,200 b=1,0 | suocext cdpmin=1 cdpmax=8 dxcdp=25 noffmix=1 offextr=100

test_cases.description: Mix two offsets using a time-varying velocity function.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,200 b=1,0 c=-8,100 j=8,8 | suocext cdpmin=1 cdpmax=8 dxcdp=25 noffmix=2 offextr=50 tdmo=0,0.4 vdmo=1500,1800 sdmo=0.6 fmax=60
